project_info.theme: YSL The Slim lipstick shade spotlight in True Chili
project_info.color_palette: Glittering deep red, white, gold, black, warm nude skin tone

main_subject.detail: A macro beauty poster showing a close-up of full lips wearing a bold matte red lipstick shade against a sparkling red glitter background. The bottom copy reads 'THE SLIM 28 TRUE CHILI' and 'ĐỎ GẠCH QUYẾN RŨ'. At the lower right is a YSL The Slim lipstick bullet.
main_subject.style: High-glam beauty macro advertising, ultra-close lip texture focus, festive red sparkle backdrop

composition_elements.text: YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTÉ; THE SLIM 28 TRUE CHILI; ĐỎ GẠCH QUYẾN RŨ
items: Top Left: YSL Beauté logo on a glittering red field
Top Right: Fine red glitter texture with gold sparkle specks
Bottom Left: Large white shade-name typography under the lip image
Bottom Right: YSL The Slim lipstick bullet in black and gold with the red shade exposed
Center/Background: Square-framed macro photo of lips wearing matte brick-red lipstick

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Soft skin diffusion, crisp lip texture, festive sparkle bokeh, premium makeup-editorial finish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square luxury beauty poster for YSL Beauté. Centerpiece is a macro close-up of lips wearing a bold matte brick-red lipstick inside a square crop on a glittering red background. Include the exact text 'THE SLIM 28 TRUE CHILI' and 'ĐỎ GẠCH QUYẾN RŨ', plus the YSL The Slim lipstick bullet at the lower right and the 'YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTÉ' logo above. Technical style: photoreal beauty macro advertising composite, glam beauty close-up lighting, crisp lip texture and festive sparkle finish, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This is a beauty macro poster. Prioritize lip texture, shade accuracy, and the festive red glitter field. Keep the square lip crop centered and the product bullet small but clear in the lower right.
